confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for the July 2026 window. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked, and no web search was used for the city-price anchors. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because July demand swings widely. Cocktail and wine anchors were set using the local price relationship to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX value comes from search excerpts that cite the RBA exchange-rates page and was not confirmed on the live page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close single-city match. Based on mid-sized Caucasus and Eastern European capitals such as Yerevan, with accommodation adjusted upward for Tbilisi's summer tourist demand.
